where.zone: deep in their own half, centrally

angle: Sartori is sent off with a second yellow at 58' — a key moment that leaves Northbridge a man down while they lead 3-0 and follows a recent Chaos Index spike.

explanation.why_it_matters: Sent off at 58', Sartori takes out a CDM who delivered 40 pressures, 30 interceptions and 97 passes (0.907), reducing Northbridge's on-ball and defensive control. With Chaos Index spiking to 88 and 73 recently and Harbourside's 204 pressures, sustaining the 0.83 control_share becomes much riskier.

en.headline: Sartori sent off — game shifts
en.body: Davide Sartori gets a second yellow at 58'. Northbridge stay ahead but now play with ten while leading 3-0.

it.headline: Sartori espulso — partita che cambia
it.body: Davide Sartori prende il secondo giallo al 58'. Northbridge restano avanti ma ora giocano in dieci pur conducendo 3-0.

es.headline: Sartori expulsado — cambia el partido
es.body: Davide Sartori recibe la segunda amarilla en el 58'. Northbridge mantienen la ventaja pero ahora juegan con diez mientras mandan 3-0.

ja.headline: Sartori sent off — game shifts
ja.body: Davide Sartori gets a second yellow at 58'. Northbridge stay ahead but now play with ten while leading 3-0.

en.headline: Control dented by late red
en.body: Chaos Index now 41 after spikes to 88 and 73; Sartori had 97 passes with DVA -0.374. His 40 pressures and 30 interceptions were key to home control now under threat.

it.headline: Controllo incrinato da un rosso tardivo
it.body: Indice del Caos ora 41 dopo picchi a 88 e 73; Sartori ha effettuato 97 passaggi con DVA -0.374. I suoi 40 pressioni e 30 intercetti sono stati fondamentali per il controllo casalingo ora sotto minaccia.

es.headline: El control dañado por la roja tardía
es.body: Índice de caos ahora 41 tras picos a 88 y 73; Sartori tuvo 97 pases con DVA -0.374. Sus 40 presiones y 30 intercepciones fueron clave para el control local, ahora en peligro.

ja.headline: 遅い退場で支配にヒビ
ja.body: Chaos Indexはスパイクで88、73を経て現在41。Davide Sartoriは97本のパス、DVA -0.374を記録。彼の40回のプレッシャーと30回のインターセプトがホームでの支配を支えていたが、今その支配が脅かされている。

en.headline: Second yellow sends Sartori off
en.body: Deep in their own half, centrally, Davide Sartori is shown a second yellow and sent off at 58'. Northbridge remain 3-0 up but are down to ten men.

it.headline: Secondo giallo, Sartori espulso
it.body: Nella parte bassa del campo, centralmente, a Davide Sartori viene mostrato il secondo cartellino giallo ed espulso al 58'. Northbridge rimangono sul 3-0 ma ora sono in dieci.

es.headline: Segunda amarilla: Sartori expulsado
es.body: Muy dentro de su propia mitad, en el centro, a Davide Sartori le enseñan la segunda tarjeta amarilla y es expulsado en el 58'. Northbridge siguen 3-0 arriba pero se quedan con diez jugadores.

ja.headline: Second yellow sends Sartori off
ja.body: Deep in their own half, centrally, Davide Sartori is shown a second yellow and sent off at 58'. Northbridge remain 3-0 up but are down to ten men.

en.headline: Sartori’s night ends early
en.body: Davide Sartori is dismissed with a second yellow at 58'. He leaves after 113 touches and 97 passes (pass accuracy 0.907), removing a major defensive presence.

it.headline: La serata di Sartori finisce prima del previsto
it.body: Davide Sartori viene espulso con un secondo giallo al 58'. Esce dopo 113 tocchi e 97 passaggi (accuratezza passaggi 0.907), perdendo una presenza difensiva importante.

es.headline: La noche de Sartori termina pronto
es.body: Davide Sartori es expulsado con una segunda amarilla en el 58'. Se marcha tras 113 toques y 97 pases (precisión de pase 0.907), perdiendo una presencia defensiva importante.

ja.headline: サルトリの夜は早く終わる
ja.body: Davide Sartoriは58分に2枚目のイエローで退場。113タッチ、97本のパス（パス成功率0.907）を残して退き、守備の主要な存在が一人いなくなった。
